info.name: Tawsela API
info.description: Complete collection generated from routes/api.php and routes/admin.php. API paths include the /api prefix. Configure base_url and token in collection variables. Admin endpoints require the authenticated admin role in addition to Sanctum authentication. Routes with missing or empty controller actions are retained and flagged in their descriptions.

request.description: Returns the current authenticated user. Requires a Sanctum bearer token.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Public authentication endpoints and authenticated account actions.

header.description: Optional: user or driver. Defaults to user.

request.description: Register an account. FormRequest: name, phone, address, image, device_id, and device_type are required; device_type is ios or android. password uses confirmed|min:6 but lacks required, while the service accesses it directly; include password and password_confirmation. X-Role optionally selects user or driver (default user). Image is uploaded as a file.

formdata.description: Required; Egyptian mobile pattern (01 followed by 9 digits).
Service requires it; validation has confirmed|min:6 but no required rule.
Confirmation for password; needed when password is supplied.
Required uploaded image (no image MIME rule in RegisterRequest).

request.description: Validate a phone or email verification code. Required: type (email|phone), value, code (6 digits).
Authenticate with email or phone. Required: type, value (email format if type=email, Egyptian phone pattern if type=phone), password, device_id, device_type (ios|android).

header.description: Optional: user or driver. Defaults to user.

request.description: Social login. Required: provider (facebook|google) and token. X-Role optionally selects user or driver; it overrides the request role during preparation and defaults to user.
Request a password-reset code. Required: type (phone|email) and value; the value format is not additionally validated.
Check a reset code. Required: type (phone|email), value, code (6 digits).
Reset password. Required: type (phone|email), value, code (6 digits), password and password_confirmation (confirmed|min:6).
Revoke the current Sanctum token. Controller also deletes device tokens matching device_id; no validation rules are defined for device_id.

Update account/profile fields. Multipart form-data supports uploaded files. Required fields vary by authenticated role; see field descriptions. Several required fields have no value/type validation beyond the listed rules.

formdata.description: Required for driver; nullable for user. 12 digits and unique except current user.
Required for driver; role-dependent; no explicit type rule.
Required for driver; role-dependent; controller stores this as license_expire_date.

request.description: Toggle the authenticated user's voice_alert setting; no request body.
Toggle the authenticated user's notification preference; no request body.
Return the authenticated user's profile; no request body.

item.name: Driver - Account
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token, role:driver, and is_account_opened.

request.description: Submit driver identity documents. Required fields: national_number (12 digits, unique), nationalId_image (image), driving_license (file <=1024 KB, pdf/doc/docx), personal_image (file <=1024 KB, png/jpg). drug_analysis and criminal_record are optional files <=1024 KB, pdf/doc/docx.

Submit vehicle details and documents. Required: car_type_id, car_brand_id, car_color, metal_plate_numbers (3 digits), model_year, license_expire_date (date), vehicle_license and vehicle_license_behind (pdf/doc/docx <=1024 KB). vehicle_inspection is optional with the same file restrictions.
Return driver registration reference data; no request inputs.
Return driver registration reference data; no request inputs.
Return driver registration reference data; no request inputs.
Return driver registration reference data; no request inputs.
Toggle the current driver's active status; no request body.
Update location and publish a location event. Controller reads latitude and longitude but defines no validation rules; both are included based on implementation.
Update location. Required numeric latitude and longitude by inline validation.
Remove the authenticated driver from online location tracking; no request body.
Return the authenticated driver's details.

item.name: Driver - Orders
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token, role:driver, and is_account_opened except payment route.

request.description: Reject a pending offer. Path `order` is model-bound. Optional `reason` string up to 1000 chars; `driver_id` is prohibited because the authenticated driver is used.
List pending order offers for the authenticated driver.
Initiate a Vonage call to the customer for this order.
Cancel an accepted order. Required body: cancel_reason.
Accept an available order.
Mark arrival for an accepted order and notify its customer.
Start an accepted drive.
Finish a started drive. waiting_price is read from the request and defaults to 0; no validation rules are defined.
Complete a finished drive.
Return driver-facing order details.

item.name: Driver - Drives and Wallet
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token, role:driver, and is_account_opened.

request.description: Return dates with recorded drives; no request inputs.
List drives. Query: skip and take pagination values, date filters by created_at (YYYY-MM-DD). No validation rules are defined.
Return the invoice for an order.
Return wallet aggregates. Optional filter query is day, week, or month (date range applies to created_at).
List notifications. Optional skip/take pagination; defaults are 0 and 10. No validation rules are defined.

item.name: Driver - Payments
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and role:driver.

request.description: Create a Stripe card token and charge the authenticated driver's current debit. Required: card-number, exp-month, exp-year, cvc. Optional description. No account-opened middleware is applied to this route.

item.name: User
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and role:user.

request.description: Send a chat message to the support chat assistant. Required: message.
Create an address. Required: type (0, 1, or 2), name, latitude (-90..90), longitude (-180..180).
List addresses for the authenticated user.
Update an address matching the path id and supplied type. Required fields are identical to address creation.
List vehicle types available for orders.

Create a drive order. Required: start/end latitude and longitude within geographic ranges, car_type_id, and numeric price. start_address/end_address, promo_code, and drive_distance are nullable per validation, but the service accesses both address keys; include them to avoid missing-key errors.
Cancel an order if allowed by order state. Required: cancel_reason.
List the authenticated user's orders. Optional skip/take pagination and filter (incoming|cancelled|completed).
Get drive details by order id.
Create a review. Required rate (1..5); optional comment.
List notifications. Optional skip/take pagination; defaults are 0 and 10.
Attach the path promotion to the authenticated user. No request validation rules are defined.

item.name: Admin - Car Types
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and the admin role middleware.

request.description: List car types.
Route is registered to CarTypeController@show, whose method is empty and returns no documented representation.
Required: name_en, name_ar, price, image. Image is uploaded as a file.

formdata.description: Required uploaded image; no MIME rule defined.

request.description: CarTypeRequest requires name_en, name_ar, price, image even though controller has fallback names. Image is uploaded as a file.
Delete a car type.

item.name: Admin - Car Brands
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and the admin role middleware.

request.description: List car brands.
Registered route targets CarTypeController@show (not CarBrandController); target method is empty. Retained as registered.
Required: name_en and name_ar.
CarBrandRequest requires name_en and name_ar.
Delete a car brand.

item.name: Admin - Promotions
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and the admin role middleware.

request.description: List promotions.
Route points to PromotionController@show, but that method is not implemented. Endpoint is registered but cannot be fully documented or expected to respond successfully.
Required: expire_date (date) and discount. No additional type/range validation is defined for discount.
Required: expire_date (date) and discount.
Delete a promotion.

item.name: Admin - Settings
item.description: Requires Sanctum bearer token and the admin role middleware.

request.description: Controller expects a settings collection keyed by existing setting keys; there are no validation rules. Values may be scalar data or uploaded files (file values replace settings-images media). Use multipart/form-data and replace the placeholder key with an existing settings key.

formdata.description: Dynamic key/value; use an existing Setting.key. For image settings, change this form-data entry type to File.
